name: web-plugins
description: Embed runtime and schema-driven config platform for website widgets

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n runtime,server,views,widget,page -c cyan,green,blue,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:runtime" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:views" "pnpm dev:widget" "pnpm dev:page"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @web-plugins/views build && pnpm --filter @web-plugins/hello-widget build && pnpm --filter @web-plugins/server build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @web-plugins/protocol build && pnpm --filter @web-plugins/runtime build && pnpm --filter @web-plugins/widget-kit build
